quests.partnerDialogue: Great job on the presentation today!
quests.question: When your roleplay partner says: "Great job on the presentation today!", which response is the most natural and appropriate?
options: Thanks a lot. I practiced for days.
Thank you. It smells delicious.
I'm full, thank you. It was great.
Sorry, I can't eat peanuts. I'm allergic.
quests.correctAnswer: Thanks a lot. I practiced for days.
quests.explanation: Admitting nerves after a success makes people warm to you.
quests.hint: Thank them and say you were nervous.

Incorrect: "Thank you. It smells delicious." is not the natural response to: "Great job on the presentation today!".
